source_document.prelude_markdown:
# Jason Playbook: Managed Activity Log

**Version:** 1.0.0  
**Status:** Production scope; exact durable owner promotion required  
**Mode:** Internal documentation only

sections.title: Section Goal
Trigger
sections.body_markdown: A ticket has persisted Jason operational activity and at least one meaningful state/reason transition.

sections.title: Scope and Boundaries
Initial Identification
sections.body_markdown:
1. Resolve exact ticket ID from persisted operational work.
2. Read that ticket's existing notes.
3. Identify at most one exact note for each managed title.
4. Require the governed note-update boundary to verify creator identity, internal visibility, and note ID.

sections.title: Expected State
sections.body_markdown: The ticket contains a compact chronological activity history reflecting meaningful Jason state transitions, with no duplicate entries for unchanged polling.

sections.title: State Model
sections.body_markdown:
`activity_detected -> rendered -> current | created | appended | rollover_created | blocked`

The source of truth is `autonomy_ticket_activity`; Autotask is the technician-readable projection.

sections.title: Diagnostic Workflow
sections.body_markdown:
### Step 1: Read persisted activity
Read ordered activity rows for the exact ticket.

### Step 2: Suppress noise
Remove consecutive rows with identical phase and reason.

### Step 3: Render deterministic chunks
Render stable timestamp/state/result entries and greedily chunk from the beginning. Existing chunk boundaries never move when new rows are appended.

### Step 4: Reconcile notes
- absent chunk -> create internal note;
- exact body -> no write;
- longer body -> append-only managed update;
- ownership/identity mismatch -> fail closed.

sections.title: Decision Gates
Remediation
sections.body_markdown:
Not applicable. Documentation only.

Allowed mutations:
- `service.ticket.note.create`
- `service.ticket.note.update`

sections.title: Retry Policy
sections.body_markdown: No provider mutation retry inside one execution plan. Later normal worker cycles may reconcile again after authoritative reread.

sections.title: Periodic Rechecks
sections.body_markdown: Normal worker scans reevaluate activity. Unchanged activity generates no Autotask write.

sections.title: Aging / Stale Condition
sections.body_markdown: Historical activity remains readable after terminal ticket state. No endless polling entries are appended.

sections.title: Dependency Handling
sections.body_markdown: If note search, ownership verification, provider authorization, or readback is unavailable, skip the documentation mutation and audit the failure. Do not block technical remediation solely because Activity projection failed.

sections.title: Documentation Requirements
Failure Handling
Escalation Criteria
sections.body_markdown: Repeated projection failures are a Jason support condition; they do not authorize altering unrelated ticket data.

sections.title: Verification
sections.body_markdown: Authoritative Autotask readback must prove exact body, note ID, internal visibility, title, and Jason creator attribution.

sections.title: Completion Criteria
sections.body_markdown: The latest meaningful persisted activity is represented in the deterministic managed-note projection, or the existing projection is already current.

sections.title: Final Resolution Note
sections.body_markdown: Not applicable. The Activity note itself is the chronological technical record.

sections.title: Required Capabilities
sections.body_markdown:
- `service.ticket.notes.search`
- `service.ticket.note.create`
- `service.ticket.note.update`
- persisted `autonomy_ticket_activity` state

sections.title: Acceptance Test
Section Goal Closure
sections.body_markdown: Close after source tests, protected CI, exact durable owner promotion, production deployment, and a controlled live work-ticket verification.

sections.title: Autonomous Execution Eligibility and Owner Review
sections.heading_markdown: ## 23. Autonomous Execution Eligibility and Owner Review
sections.body_markdown:
Production nomination: `autonomy.activation=autonomous`.

Exact promoted scope:
- playbook: `jason_activity_log@1.0.0`
- policy: `playbook-autonomy:jason_activity_log`
- capabilities: `service.ticket.note.create`, `service.ticket.note.update`

Any material expansion beyond Jason-owned internal documentation requires new owner review.

required_before_activation: Exact-capability binding and source-scoped argument context verified
Safe diagnostic and remediation branches mapped to governed capabilities
Durable retry/wait/terminal lifecycle parity with shared runtime
Error, negative-evidence and client-boundary regression tests
Controlled shadow comparison and independent acceptance
Owner-bound activation and branch-specific autonomous promotion
